briefs.headline: New SSM Filing Requirements: What Every Director Must Know
briefs.summary: The Companies Commission of Malaysia (SSM) has issued updated guidelines for company directors regarding annual filing requirements effective April 2025. Changes include revised submission timelines, mandatory digital signature verification, and increased penalties for late filings under the Companies Act 2016.

briefs.headline: 2025 Audit Report: Key Findings & Compliance Action Items
briefs.summary: The National Audit Department of Malaysia (Jabatan Audit Negara) has released its Q1 2025 compliance findings. The report highlights recurring weaknesses in procurement documentation, internal control frameworks, and financial reporting timelines across audited entities including government-linked companies.

briefs.headline: New MFRS Standard Update: Are Your Accounts Ready?
briefs.summary: ACCA Malaysia and the Malaysian Accounting Standards Board (MASB) have announced significant updates to the MFRS framework effective Q3 2025. The changes affect revenue recognition under MFRS 15, lease accounting under MFRS 16, and financial instrument measurement. A CPD webinar series runs throughout April and May.
